name: W Koh Samui
short_description: Design-led W Hotels resort on Mae Nam Beach, Ko Samui's north coast, with 74 all private-pool villas, WOOBAR nightly fire shows and a lively beach scene.
ai_summary: W Koh Samui is a design-forward, all-villa W Hotels resort spread across a tiered hillside above Mae Nam Beach on the island's north coast. All 74 villas come with a private outdoor pool, generous decks and bold, colour-drenched W styling; reviewers consistently single out the size and privacy of the accommodation, with entry categories still far larger than most island rivals. Independent writers praise the property's strong service and elite recognition, including reliable upgrades, early check-in and late check-out, plus the signature W energy at WOOBAR, where the nightly fire show is repeatedly called among the best on Samui. Dining spans all-day fare at The Kitchen Table and Japanese-Asian plates at Namu, and the free all-day Sweet Spot ice cream and soft-drink stations are a recurring favourite. Watch-outs are also consistent across reviews: the beach has coarse, gritty sand that is uncomfortable underfoot; the steep hillside layout means frequent reliance on buggy transfers, which can challenge guests with mobility needs; and breakfast draws mixed reviews, described as repetitive and underwhelming for the price point. Several reviewers, noting the resort opened in 2010, mention the villas are showing their age and could be due a refresh. On balance it remains a highly regarded luxury and points-redemption pick for couples and families who value space, service and scene over a picture-perfect swimming beach.

faqs.question: Does every room at W Koh Samui have a private pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. W Koh Samui is an all-villa resort with 74 villas, and every villa comes with its own private outdoor pool plus a large deck. Categories range from garden and jungle villas up to spacious ocean-front villas, all styled in the bold, design-led W aesthetic.

faqs.question: How far is W Koh Samui from Samui International Airport?
faqs.answer: The resort sits on Mae Nam Beach on the island's north coast, roughly 9 km from Samui International Airport (USM), which is about a 20-minute drive. It is also a short drive from Bophut's Fisherman's Village and the Big Buddha Temple.

faqs.question: What do guests dislike about W Koh Samui?
faqs.answer: The most common complaints are the coarse, gritty beach sand, the steep hillside layout that relies on buggy transfers, and breakfast that reviewers call repetitive or underwhelming for the price. Some also note the 2010-era villas are showing their age and could use a refresh.

reviews.title: Review: W Koh Samui
reviews.author: Audrey Voisine
reviews.summary: Family stay in a garden villa with private pool. Praises bold W design, a standout fire show and kind staff; flags coarse beach sand, buggy-reliant hillside layout and a repetitive breakfast.

reviews.title: Review: W Koh Samui (Ocean Front Haven Villa)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: Elite guest scores a five-category upgrade to an ocean-front villa with early check-in and late checkout. Loves the beach, buggy service and Sweet Spot but finds breakfast weak and villas showing their 14-year age.

reviews.title: Review: The W Ko Samui, Thailand
reviews.author: Mark LePage
reviews.summary: Six-night stay in a huge ~2,400 sq ft Ocean Front Haven Villa. Highlights space, private infinity pool and elite breakfast perks; notes walled-off ocean views, coarse sand, mosquitoes and merely adequate food.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: The W Koh Samui in Thailand
reviews.author: Brian Kelly
reviews.summary: Two-night stay with mixed impressions: praises the striking lobby, service, WOO Bar cocktails and a beach barbecue, but is let down by the lack of ocean views and high pricing relative to value.

reviews.title: Review: W Koh Samui
reviews.summary: All-villa resort review with a semi-private beach of loungers and daybeds. Notes cash rates around 16,700 THB or roughly 65,000 Bonvoy points per night, weighing the property's design and service against the cost.
